TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings demonstrated experience delivering secure, user-facing digital platforms, enterprise integrations, and cloud deployments for Federal/Provincial Government and private-sector clients [CO-PROFILE]. While our case library does not yet evidence a corporate website build specifically, it does evidence multiple large-scale software development and deployment engagements (well above PKR 5 million) within the last five years—meeting the “three web or software development projects” threshold through software development references [CAP-010][CAP-046][CAP-002].

Closest functional alignment to State Life’s customer self-service portal (secure access, transactions, and integrations) is our Mobile Banking work: Mobile Banking deployments valued at PKR 41M (19 months, completed 2024) [CAP-035], PKR 121M (23 months, completed 2020) [CAP-023], and PKR 85M (14 months, completed 2019) [CAP-011]. These engagements evidence our ability to deliver high-volume, security-sensitive customer channels and handle transaction flows at enterprise scale [CAP-035][CAP-023][CAP-011].

For “design, development, deployment” of a modern platform with backend integration and operations, we also cite:
- LMS Development: PKR 199M (23 months, Federal Govt, completed 2022) [CAP-010] and PKR 102M (25 months, Provincial Govt, completed 2023) [CAP-046]
- Cloud Infrastructure: PKR 108M (33 months, Federal Govt, completed 2025) [CAP-012]

We are certified to ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 as required [CO-PROFILE], registered with FBR with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status [CO-PROFILE], and maintain an in-country support desk with 24–48 hour response SLAs for O&M support [CO-PROFILE].
